reference: If the defender hadn't tripped her, there would have been no penalty.
sk: Keby ju obranca nezrazil, žiadna penalta by nebola.
cz: Kdyby ji obránce nesrazil, žádná penalta by nebyla.
acceptable: If the defender hadn't {tripped her|fouled her|brought her down|knocked her down}, there {would have been no penalty|wouldn't have been a penalty|wouldn't have been any penalty}.
There {would have been no penalty|wouldn't have been a penalty|wouldn't have been any penalty} if the defender hadn't {tripped her|fouled her|brought her down|knocked her down}.

mistakes.text: If the defender didn't trip her, there would be no penalty.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o minulosť, ktorá sa nestala, preto Third Conditional: „hadn't tripped … would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o minulost, která se nestala, proto Third Conditional: „hadn't tripped … would have been“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is about an unreal past, so use the Third Conditional: “hadn't tripped … would have been”.

mistakes.text: If the defender wouldn't have tripped her, there would have been no penalty.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; v Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „hadn't tripped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; ve Third Conditional je tam Past Perfect: „hadn't tripped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; the Third Conditional uses the Past Perfect there: “hadn't tripped”.

mistakes.text: If the defender hadn't tripped her, there wouldn't have been no penalty.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V angličtine je len jeden zápor: „would have been no penalty“ alebo „wouldn't have been a penalty“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V angličtině je jen jeden zápor: „would have been no penalty“ nebo „wouldn't have been a penalty“.
mistakes.feedback_en: English uses only one negative: “would have been no penalty” or “wouldn't have been a penalty”.

mistakes.text: If the defender hadn't tripped her, would have been no penalty.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „there“: „there would have been no penalty“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „there“: „there would have been no penalty“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “There” is missing: “there would have been no penalty”.

mistakes.text: If defender hadn't tripped her, there would have been no penalty.
